watch.summary: A streamer hypes himself up and celebrates early while playing an egg platformer game, only to immediately fail and break his egg.

beats.what: Streamer hypes himself up, declaring he is locking in and being methodical.
He carefully maneuvers the egg down a tricky obstacle track.
He starts screaming and celebrating prematurely ('I'M BETTER!').
The egg bounces off track and cracks on the ground.
Streamer screams in anguish and grabs his head.

watch.author: creator
watch.why: The classic comedy formula of premature celebration leading directly into sudden failure delivers instantly recognizable and satisfying comedy.
